notes.title: Steam Workshop and OST now live for Kitsune Tails
notes.content:
Creators of custom levels or minigames can easily [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1325260/discussions/0/4522261847578627082/]upload their mods to Steam Workshop[/url] with the press of a button from inside the game. Players can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1325260]subscribe to mods via Steam Workshop[/url] and they'll appear automatically in the mods menu, prefixed with a little Steam icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39580906/b68e6f7b8d22676e4aa5b55e17edc42886cbdafe.gif[/img]

You can make custom levels for Kitsune Tails using the free and open source Tiled Map Editor, and make your own minigames using a simple framework using Lua, the same way we made the minigames in the arcade. Check the Steam forum for instructions on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1325260/discussions/0/4522261847578627082/]how to get started with modding and Steam Workshop[/url].

[h1]OST now available on Steam[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39580906/acad626111885471429e15a6cefa10337740ad14.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39580906/e983a164eef613c5587f0a66bbfae02d1e494179.png[/img][/url]

Now available on Steam, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181440/Kitsune_Tails_Soundtrack]Kitsune Tails OST[/url] is inspired by classics such as The Legend of the Mystical Ninja/Ganbare Goemon from the 16-bit era. Featuring 7 overworld themes, 10 stage themes, the festival dance music, and more. It's available by itself or bundled with the game as the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44581/Kitsune_Tails_Deluxe_Edition]Deluxe Edition[/url] and includes both MP3 and FLAC files for all tracks.

[h1]Other new features[/h1]

An often requested feature is a way to swap characters after beating the game, you can now do so with the special button.

Speedrunners will be happy to know that we've added in-game timers for total game length (stored with your save) and time spent inside a stage. These can be toggled on in the options menu.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181440/Kitsune_Tails_Soundtrack]OST[/url] is now available on Steam
[*]You can now swap characters with the special button after beating the game
[*]Steam Workshop integration, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1325260/discussions/0/4522261847578627082/]modding thread for more information[/url]
[*]Subscribed Steam Workshop mods in the mods menu are marked by the Steam icon
[*]Added the ability to toggle on a time played timer and level timer to the options menu
[*]Updated libsteam_api.so for Linux versions to fix a sporadic crash on launch issue
[*]Change #if GL_ES to #ifdef GL_ES in ntsc-generate-screen-texture.frag (fixes issues for players attempting to play on MacOS)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Add low-flashing version of eel tileset.
[*]Haunted Heist minigame should no longer churn through RAM on systems with misbehaving GPU drivers.
[*]Make live Haunted Heist decoy fade into darkness properly.
[*]Fix triggerable tutorial textboxes being always visible on repeat visits.
[*]Moved rolling skulls just before outside section in 2-4 slightly to the right.
[*]Second room in 2-4 no longer requires jump speed to get up the moving block with the apple power up.
[*]Made the jump to the treasure boxes at the very top of the 2nd room of 4-4 easier.
[*]Changed 4-6 so moving platforms are always on the same cycle.
[*]Add 5-1 glide tutorial.
[*]The groups of three oncoming moving platforms in the 2nd room of 5-3 now consistently activate together.
[*]Nerfed the heck out of 5-4.
[*]Made the first spikes in 5-6 lower, added an air power up.
[*]Platform flanked by tanuki ninjas in 5-7 no longer requires run speed to jump up.
[*]6-3 no longer has a slope into lava.
[*]Made moving platform at end of 6-3 slightly slower.
[*]Made 2nd moving platform in the 2nd room of 6-7 slightly slower.
[*]Fix lava at very end of 6-7.
[/list]

notes.title: Yes: Kitsune Tails is Steam Deck verified
notes.content: Many people have asked if Kitsune Tails works on Steam Deck, and this post is here to answer that question: it works great! With a native Linux port and support for all major controllers, including the XInput configuration buttons the Steam Deck uses, Kitsune Tails will be a great experience on your Steam Deck. In fact, many [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/ojrac/recommended/1325260/]Steam reviews[/url] mention [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197983083564/recommended/1325260/]how great[/url] it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kithop/recommended/1325260/]works on Steam Deck[/url].

notes.title: Kitsune Tails coming to Steam August 1st!
notes.content:
Kitsune Tails has a release date! As just announced on Wholesome Direct, our Mario-like featuring queer fox girls will be coming to Steam (Windows, Linux) on August 1st, 2024! But there's also a Steam Next Fest demo out right now for you to play and enjoy. Check out our release date trailer on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325260/Kitsune_Tails/]the store page[/url] or on YouTube below.

For those of you who enjoyed the demo in the last few days, we've updated the demo build with many refinements based on your excellent feedback. [b]Chief amongst them the super fox power up[/b], which now switches from its own jingle back to the stage theme a little before the power runs out. The rainbow colors also become much more muted as a visual cue for those of you who play with the music off.

[previewyoutube=eW3RF5QYzag;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Kitsune Tails in Women’s Day event
notes.content:
Today kicks off the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womenday]Women’s Day Event[/url] on Steam! With over 200 games made by women-led studios, this Event features games from developers from all over the world, with demos and discounts on select titles, plus previews of soon-to-be released games.

During the event we'll be live streaming some exclusive gameplay footage, featuring a haunted house level from Kitsune Tails. Don't worry about missing it, it'll be on loop all week!

notes.title: New Kitsune Tails trailer shows elemental power ups!
notes.content:
Good news everyone, to celebrate the news that Kitsune Tails will also be coming to Nintendo Switch we've put together a new trailer for the game, showcasing Yuzu in different states of power up:

[previewyoutube=pcT80_hs-hg;full][/previewyoutube]
The earth power up has a straw hat which functions like a drill using breakdancing moves inspired by Samurai Champloo, while the arctic fox's ice power up shoots ice projectiles which freezes enemies into solid platforms. Finally there's Yuzu as a tiny fox, a form she reverts to upon taking damage to give the player a chance to recover.

Which is your favorite? Let us know by leaving a comment!
